queries.item: DELETE FROM ?:privileges WHERE section_id LIKE 'ab__seo_filters' OR group_id = 'ab__seo_filters'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sf_names ( sf_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, category_id int(10) unsigned NOT NULL, features_hash varchar(100) NOT NULL, fixed char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'U', company_id int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', show_in_breadcrumbs CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', show_in_subcategory_block CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', is_noindex CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', position_in_subcategory_block int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', edit_mark CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', PRIMARY KEY (sf_id), KEY fixed_category_hash (fixed,category_id,features_hash) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sf_name_descriptions ( sf_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', lang_code char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', name varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', name_in_subcategory_block varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', description mediumtext, short_description text, meta_keywords varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', meta_description varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', page_title varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tag_h1 varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', breadcrumb varchar(255) NOT NULL, product_breadcrumb varchar(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sf_id,lang_code), KEY name__lang_code (name,lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sf_rules ( rule_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, feature_id text NOT NULL, categories text NOT NULL, subcats char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', position int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, fixed char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'U', status char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'D', generated_categories enum('by_all_filter_categories','by_non_empty_filter_categories') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'by_all_filter_categories', company_id int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', show_in_breadcrumbs CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', link_pattern varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'variant', autogenerate CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', canonical_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (rule_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sf_rule_descriptions ( rule_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', lang_code char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', description mediumtext, short_description text, meta_keywords varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', meta_description varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', page_title varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tag_h1 varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', breadcrumb varchar(255) NOT NULL, product_breadcrumb varchar(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rule_id,lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sf_patterns ( pattern varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', lang_code char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', value varchar(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', company_id int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (pattern,lang_code,company_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
